metadata.question: From January to mid-May, did Jaén a few miles east of Córdoba recieve more than 3 inches of rain fall in 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for 2023-01-01 to 2023-05-16 (end exclusive), location near Jaén, Spain (point at 37.7796, -3.7849) buffered 15 km. If CHIRPS has no images, fallback to ERA5-LAND Daily Aggregated (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR).
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for precipitation datasets. Just sum precipitation and compute regional mean.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null/Error: Check collection size; if zero after fallback -> C1. Compute valid pixel count; if zero -> C2. If mean precipitation is null/NaN/negative -> C3. Otherwise compare inches > 3 to output A (Yes) or B (No).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfo(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const jaenPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-3.7849, 37.7796]);
    const region = jaenPoint.buffer(15000); // 15 km radius around Jaén
    const start = '2023-01-01';
    const end = '2023-05-16'; // end is exclusive, so includes May 15

    const scale = 5000; // meters
    let dataset = 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY';
    let band = 'precipitation'; // mm/day for CHIRPS
    let sumImg = null;
    let imgCount = 0;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (CHIRPS -> fallback ERA5 if needed)
    let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(region).select(band);
    imgCount = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (imgCount === 0) {
      // Fallback: ERA5-LAND DAILY_AGGR total_precipitation_sum (m/day), convert to mm
      dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR';
      band = 'total_precipitation_sum';
      let colEra5 = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(region).select(band);
      imgCount = await getInfo(colEra5.size());
      if (imgCount === 0) {
        console.log('Location: Jaén, Spain (15 km buffer)');
        console.log('Dates: 2023-01-01 to 2023-05-15');
        console.log('Dataset Used: None (CHIRPS, ERA5 fallback both empty)');
        console.log('Images: 0');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      // Sum and convert to mm; rename to harmonize band name
      sumImg = colEra5.sum().multiply(1000).rename('precipitation'); // mm total
      band = 'precipitation';
    } else {
      sumImg = col.sum(); // mm total
    }

    // 3. Processing: Pixel count to detect C2
    const countDict = sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const validPix = await getInfo(countDict.get(band));
    if (!validPix || validPix === 0) {
      console.log('Location: Jaén, Spain (15 km buffer)');
      console.log('Dates: 2023-01-01 to 2023-05-15');
      console.log(`Dataset Used: ${dataset}`);
      console.log(`Images: ${imgCount}`);
      console.log('Valid Pixels: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: Mean precipitation over region (mm), then inches
    const meanDict = sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const precipMm = await getInfo(meanDict.get(band)); // mm total (area-mean)
    if (precipMm === null || isNaN(precipMm) || precipMm < 0) {
      console.log('Location: Jaén, Spain (15 km buffer)');
      console.log('Dates: 2023-01-01 to 2023-05-15');
      console.log(`Dataset Used: ${dataset}`);
      console.log(`Images: ${imgCount}`);
      console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${validPix}`);
      console.log('Computation invalid (null/NaN/negative).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const precipIn = precipMm / 25.4;

    // 5. Output concise evidence and final answer
    console.log('Location: Jaén, Spain (15 km buffer)');
    console.log('Dates: 2023-01-01 to 2023-05-15');
    console.log(`Dataset Used: ${dataset}`);
    console.log(`Images: ${imgCount}`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${validPix}`);
    console.log(`Total Precipitation: ${precipMm.toFixed(1)} mm (${precipIn.toFixed(2)} in)`);

    const answer = precipIn > 3.0 ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    // Any dataset/band/syntax/memory error -> D
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
